verdict.rationale: An isolated sandbox environment is a fair capability to ask of an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a sandbox or isolated test environment. The only nearby items are a user running Windows inside a VM on Linux (a user-side workaround) and WSL (an adjacent feature, not a sandbox); neither counts, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
